title: End-to-end user journeys
notes: These proposed journeys explain who enters each screen, which guards apply, what changes, and how users recover/hand work on. They do not provision accounts/services, send messages, migrate production data or prove implementation. Final department stages, action rights, SLA/numbering and privacy/retention need the named decision owners. Each stage links canonical requirement IDs; tests use clearly fictitious sandbox records. Workspace is organizational context; each project uses Overview / Work / Resources.
